About us:

About SIS
Stockholm International School is a truly international K-12 school located in the heart of the dynamic city of Stockholm. We are the first choice for the globally mobile diplomatic, business and research community in Sweden. Our students represent more than 60 countries and our diverse community is made up of over 80% international students and teaching staff. Our language of learning is English but our outlook is global.
Job Overview
Stockholm International School is seeking a Tech Support Specialist to join our dynamic IT Team and empower all SIS employees and students to do their best work. You will focus on removing technical barriers to productivity and learning  and finding creative solutions to new challenges. 
The IT Team at SIS is a flexible and agile team, responsible for a wide variety of services and processes and you will play a key role in removing technical barriers and delivering high-quality services to SIS employees and students. You will be responsible for maintaining and enhancing IT infrastructure, including managing a variety of cloud-based networking solutions, while ensuring the smooth daily operation of all IT systems. Your contributions will directly impact the learning experience at Stockholm International School, empowering students and staff through technology-driven solutions.
Duties/responsibilities
Manage, and maintain the school's cloud-based network infrastructure, ensuring high availability, stability, and security for both wired and wireless networks across the campus.
Troubleshoot network, infrastructure and hardware issues proactively, preventing downtime and ensuring the network runs smoothly. 
Leverage network automation tools to monitor and resolve issues before they impact users.
Assist in implementing and managing network security protocols.
Ensure the school’s digital environment adheres to secure networking best practices.
Leverage automation tools and network management solutions, to address potential issues and streamline IT operations.
Install, configure, and maintain a variety of devices (macOS, ChromeOS, Windows, iOS) across the network. 
Manage Mobile Device Management (MDM) platform, to streamline device deployments and ensure compliance with security policies.
Provide prompt, friendly, and effective support to students, teachers, and staff for their IT needs, ensuring technology enhances the learning and/or working experience.
Help teachers integrate technology into their classrooms by assisting with device setup (such as interactive displays, projectors, and mobile devices).
Offer student tech support, including assistance with educational devices (iPads, Chromebooks, Macbooks) and applications used in learning, such as Google Workspace and classroom-specific tools.
Assist in maintaining and troubleshooting IT resources for school events, such as assemblies, ensuring that audio-visual and conferencing systems work seamlessly.
Organize and run IT support drop-in sessions (Tech Bar) where students and staff can get help for technical issues or receive training on school systems and software.
Provide technical support for school events, including evening and weekend activities, as needed.

Qualifications, Attributes and Experience 
You have experience supporting macOS, ChromeOS, and Windows-based systems and enjoy providing personal support to help users solve technical problems.
You are familiar with network management tools, including Cisco Meraki or similar cloud-based networking platforms.
You have a basic understanding of Linux and have exposure to scripting and terminal use.
You are familiar with Mobile Device Management platforms.
You articulate yourself well in English, vocally and in writing
You have strong problem-solving abilities with a proactive mindset and are able to work independently and collaboratively.
You are a curious person and a fast learner. You enjoy diving into new technologies and tools.
You have a degree or diploma (Yrkeshögskolan or equivalent) in computer science, management information systems, engineering, or a related field.
You are sensitive to cultural differences and eager to work in a diverse, multicultural environment.
You are able to prioritise and manage multiple cases effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus points for
Experience working in a fast-paced school environment
Experience with Google Workplace, Jamf Pro and other applicable cloud services
Understanding of secure networking best practices
Working knowledge of Swedish.

Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned as needed, in line with the role and the needs of the organisation.
At Stockholm International School we are committed to protecting children. Aligned with the recommendations of the International Task Force on Child Protection, we hold ourselves to a high standard of effective recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All applicants will therefore be required to undergo appropriate child protection screening. Included in the recruitment process will be a local and national police check as well as a mandatory police background check for the last 10 years of employment in every country worked. A judicial background check will be conducted prior to the issuance of the contract for prospective candidates applying to work at our school.
What we offer
As well as the exciting opportunities this role presents, we also offer benefits in terms of: a pension scheme (Alecta ITP 1/ITP2), a generous wellness stipend, other insurances, and a substantial amount of professional development opportunities inside and outside the school. We also offer staff events and social gatherings that bring colleagues together, for example, hobby evenings and choir practices.

Permanent Administrative Position (with  six-month probationary period)
Employment Rate: 100%
Start Date: 11 January 2027

Individually negotiated

We only accept applications in English and from qualified candidates.
Please send a letter of interest and your CV to application@intsch.se. Mark the email with “Tech Support Specialist”.

Lead the Business Area security team and drive a strong security culture and awareness. 
Manage information security risks across IT, OT and digital products. 
Ensure and monitor compliance with Sandvik requirements, applicable laws and regulations, customer requirements and Business Area maturity targets. 
Advise Business Area Management on information security and cyber risk, and report on compliance to Business Area Management and the Sandvik CISO.

Location & flexibility 
This position is flexible within Europe, and regular international travel is expected. 
Your profile 
You’re an experienced information security leader with a strong track record from a large, international organization. Your background combines strategic security leadership with risk and compliance management across IT and OT environments, preferably including digital products.  
Your background includes: 
Extensive experience in information security leadership, risk management and compliance. 
Experience leading a team and advising and communicating with executive management. 
A university degree in information security, computer science, engineering or equivalent. 
Professional fluency in English. 
Strong capabilities in organizational leadership, change management, strategic planning and executive stakeholder management.  

Knowledge of information security laws, regulations and standards such as EU NIS2, the EU Cyber Resilience Act, the EU AI Act, ISO 27001 and IEC 62443 are an advantage, as is a recognized information security certification.

Take the lead in developing our growing Order Desk in Svedala. We’re looking for an experienced supply chain and order management professional with a genuine interest in leadership and people development, and the ambition to grow as a leader. 
Here, you get the opportunity to:  
Shape processes, ways of working and service levels in a new position. 
Lead and develop a team with broad expertise across the order flow.  
Collaborate across a global network of sales areas, production units, suppliers and logistics partners.   

About your job
You lead and develop our Order Desk, taking end-to-end responsibility for the flow from customer order through delivery to invoicing. By creating structure, strengthening performance and ensuring reliable execution, you help us provide excellent customer service and on-time delivery.  
Job responsibilities:  
Lead and coach your team to ensure timely and accurate processing of customer orders.  
Manage the order backlog, allocation and customer communication during supply disruption. 
Resolve escalated customer issues and coordinate corrective actions. 
Oversee inbound and outbound logistics, freight partner relationships and correct invoicing.  
Establish and monitor service levels and performance indicators related to delivery, lead time, customer satisfaction and employee engagement.  
Set objectives, and collaborate with sales areas, production units as well as regional and global stakeholders.  

 
Location and flexibility
This position is in Svedala, just outside of Malmö, Sweden, with a hybrid working model.  
Your profile
With several years of experience in order management, customer service or supply chain, you understand how to create and efficient and dependable order flow. You’ve also demonstrated a genuine interest in leadership and people development, ideally combined with previous leadership or team coordination experience. 
Your background includes 
A bachelor’s or master’s degree in supply chain, logistics, business, engineering or a related field.  
Experience working with internation stakeholders. 
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office. 
Fluency in English, while knowledge of Swedish or Finnish is a plus. 
Knowledge of sales and operations planning, inventory control, process improvement, trade compliance or ERP systems is also valued. 

 
A strong sense of ownership helps you move work forward and take responsibility for results. Structured and accurate, you remain calm when priorities shift and approach challenges with practical, solution-oriented mindset. Collaboration comes naturally, and you’re motivated by developing both people and processes.
